title: Pen tool — Bézier path authoring with anchor editing
description: Implement the Pen tool (P key) with add/delete/convert-anchor sub-tools and cursor feedback. Users should be able to place explicit Bézier anchors and drag handles. See docs/04-toolbox.md. No existing task covers this — pencil/brush/eraser were done in 0692 but the Pen tool is a separate primitive.
